messages:
miriam: quick heads up — we started getting tickets: TS SDK clients returning 400s in prod after yesterday's client regen.
jon: which endpoint? any common pattern in the payloads?
miriam: /v1/rerank and /v1/generate mainly. Looks like enum query/body param is being sent as an empty string `""` instead of being omitted when not provided. server validation now rejects it.
kevin: that smells like the openapi generator changed how it serializes optional enums. did we update the generator version in CI?
miriam: yes — CI bumped openapi-generator-cli from 6.4.0 -> 6.6.1 in the regen job (see CI job 4521). I tested locally by regenerating the TS client and saw the same behavior.
ashley: can you paste a minimal repro? I can try to patch the generator config.
miriam: repro below — install freshly generated client and run:

```
# from a scratch dir
npm i ../generated/ts-client
node -e "const c=require('sample-ts-client'); console.log(JSON.stringify(c.callRerank({model:'r1', flavor: undefined}), null, 2));"
```

The request payload includes `"flavor": ""` even though we passed `undefined`.
jon: ouch. any failing tests in CI? did we miss a contract test?
ashley: CI unit tests passed because they assert types/exports, not serialization shape. The integration tests that would catch this are gated and weren't run in the regen job (cost reasons).
ci-bot: CI job #4521: openapi-regen-ts finished -> artifacts uploaded -> no integration test run
support-bot: 3 customer tickets opened (IDs: T-9812, T-9816, T-9821) — all with 400/invalid_enum
kevin: what's the easiest patch? force client to omit empty-string enums, or pin generator back?
miriam: two immediate options:
1) revert the openapi-generator bump in the regen pipeline (quick rollback) — PR ready: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdks/pull/4212
2) add a post-generate transform that strips `""` for optional enums by changing the serializer helper to `if (value === "" || value == null) return undefined` — more surgical but slightly uglier

I lean revert+investigate.
ashley: agree. revert first so customers stop getting 400s. I'll open rollback PR and trigger regen with pinned 6.4.0; then we can run the integration suite.
jon: follow-up: Why did the generator change? any upstream bug/behavior change we should track?
miriam: looks like upstream changed handling for `nullable` + `enum` combos. The generator now emits `""` for `nullable: true` when default/undefined. Upstream issue: https://github.com/OpenAPITools/openapi-generator/issues/12345
kevin: will we need to adjust changelog or patch notes? customers will see client version bump — we should add a breaking note.
ashley: yep. I'll add a changelog entry: "TS client regen (rollback): fixed enum serialization that caused 400s — do not upgrade until 6.6.x fix confirmed." and include repro steps.
miriam: opened support reply drafts for the three tickets with workaround (pin to previous SDK version) and ETA ~1h for rollback deployment.
support-bot: ticket T-9812 updated: workaround included, awaiting customer confirmation.
jon: also create a short e2e test to assert enums are omitted when undefined — add to regen CI job so this doesn't slip.
miriam: added task to PR #4212 to add that test. I'll also add an assert in our integration harness:

```
expect(serializedRequest).not.toContain('"flavor":""');
```

kevin: once rollback is live, let's run a quick smoke against a few affected customers.
ashley: rollback PR merged, triggering regen pipeline pinned to 6.4.0. CI will run with integration stage this time.
ci-bot: CI job #4528: openapi-regen-ts (pinned) started -> running integration tests
miriam: thanks all — keeping this thread open until all three tickets confirm.
support-bot: ticket T-9816: customer confirmed SDK downgrade fixed their 400s.
support-bot: ticket T-9821: awaiting customer verification.
jon: long-term: we should add a bump checklist for generator upgrades: run full integration, check nullable+enum combos, and run a small fleet smoke.
miriam: +1. I'll add a checklist section to the regen playbook and post a short note in #eng-releases.
kevin: good call. closing actions: rollback done, integration tests added to regen CI, issue tracked upstream (#12345), changelog/notes + support replies sent.
miriam: great work. I’ll update tickets and close once last customer confirms.
